messages:
anya: Quick sync: planned change window tomorrow 03:00 UTC for a coordinated rollout across runtime, router, and console. Need a single sequence and explicit rollback owners.
kevin: I'll own the runtime piece. I'll watch p50/p95/p99 and KV hit rates.
jason: Router team will own header translation. We'll be present during the window. Plan to stage header swap after a small runtime canary.
maria: Console will be feature-flagged. Request to keep an independent unflag path so we can revert UI changes without touching runtime/router.
deploy-bot: New rollout draft created: rollout/6723456789. Sequence proposed: runtime-canary(5%) -> router-canary(10%) -> console-flag(50%) -> full-shift.
anya: Rollback thresholds (hard): runtime p99 > 220ms sustained 5m OR runtime errors > 1% over 3m -> immediate rollback.
kevin: Adding infra triggers: GPU OOMs, host OOMs, or KV eviction spike > 3x baseline -> rollback. Will surface alerts in runbook.
jason: Router trigger: 4xx delta > 0.4% vs baseline over 3m OR mismatch count in header schema tests -> revert header-swap. We'll maintain router:v3-pin ready.
maria: Console triggers: UI error rate > 0.25% OR feature telemetry missing for > 2 min -> flip flag off. console:pin-20260324 available.
sre-oncall: I'll be the signal owner for infra. I will call rollback on infra signals. For user-impact rollbacks, product/eng lead to decide.
anya: Who calls T-15 go/no-go? Need a single person to give the final thumbs.
sre-oncall: I'll confirm infra green at T-15. Anya you call product go/no-go for user impact. If either vetoes, don't proceed.
kevin: I'll publish the smoke tests into the release doc: long-seq runtime paths, KV-hot prefixes, and token throughput checks.
jason: Router will run a compatibility matrix against old/new headers and include automated fail-on-mismatch in the canary job.
maria: Console will hold admin features behind the flag for 90 minutes post-shift, then ramp to normal if stable.
deploy-bot: Runbook snippet inserted into rollout/6723456789 and attached to release notes. Snippet: ```sequence: - runtime: canary=5% wait=10m - router: canary=10% wait=7m - console: flag=50% wait=10m - traffic-shift: 100% rollback_triggers: - runtime_p99_ms: 220 - runtime_error_pct: 1 - router_4xx_delta_pct: 0.4 - console_ui_error_pct: 0.25 owners: runtime: kevin router: jason console: maria signal_owner: sre-oncall```
anya: Good. I added the pinned variant names to the notes. Teams, please add the synthetic traffic patterns to the release page so we can run during canary.
kevin: Done. Smoke job will run every 5m during canary and post results to the rollout page.
jason: Router will also stream header-compat logs to the release page.
maria: I'll add a step to verify flag rollbacks don't leave stale admin routes.
sre-oncall: I'll post 5-minute heartbeat pings and escalate to pager on any infra trigger.
anya: Final: SRE confirms infra, I confirm user-impact at T-15, deploy-bot proceeds if green. If any owner calls fail, we halt and pin back. :thumbsup:
